options.content:
### Fledge OData for Grafana – Business Overview

A generic, cross-customer starting point built on the **Fledge OData v2** datasource. It covers **Sales Orders**, **Production Orders**, **Purchasing** and **Relations (CRM)**, and is meant as a bundled example — duplicate it and adapt it to your own reporting needs.

- **Administration** (top left) scopes every panel except the Relations row (Relations are not administration-scoped in the OData model). Leave it on *All* to see every administration at once.
- The dashboard's time range filters every panel on that section's date field (order date, or first-contact date for Relations) — it defaults to the last 90 days through the next 60 days to show recent activity together with near-term planning.
- Panels mix **server-side aggregation** (OData `$apply`/groupby, e.g. the value-over-time charts) with **client-side transformations** (Grafana's own group-by/reduce, e.g. the Relations breakdowns) — both are fully supported by this datasource.

panels.title: Open Sales Orders
panels.description: Sales order headers not yet locked, with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Sales Order Bookings (Period)
panels.description: Sum of sales order line value (price_local_currency_gross) booked with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Sales Order Lines (Period)
panels.description: Count of sales order lines with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Customers Ordering (Period)
panels.description: Distinct debtors that placed a sales order with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Sales Order Bookings Over Time
panels.description: Sales order line value summed per order date, computed server-side via OData $apply groupby/aggregate.

panels.title: Sales Order Value by Type
panels.description: Sales order line value grouped by the Fledge sales order type code (server-side $apply), scoped to the current time range.

panels.title: Recent Sales Orders
panels.description: Sales order headers with an order date in the current time range, newest first.

panels.title: Production Orders (Period)
panels.description: Production order headers with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Flagged for Planning
panels.description: Production orders flagged to be planned, with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Pre-calculated Cost (Period)
panels.description: Sum of pre-calculated total cost (cost_total_pre_calculation) for production orders with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Pre-calculated Hours (Period)
panels.description: Sum of pre-calculated total hours (total_hours_pre_calculation) for production orders with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Pre-calculated Cost Over Time
panels.description: Production order pre-calculated total cost summed per order date (server-side $apply).

panels.title: Pre-calculated Hours Over Time
panels.description: Production order pre-calculated total hours summed per order date (client-side aggregation - see panel description above for why).

panels.title: Top 10 Production Orders by Pre-calculated Cost
panels.description: Highest pre-calculated total cost per production order, for orders with an order date in the current time range (server-side $apply, top 10 client-side).

panels.title: Recent Production Orders
panels.description: Production order headers with an order date in the current time range, newest first.

panels.title: Open Purchase Orders
panels.description: Purchase order headers not yet closed, with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Purchase Orders (Period)
panels.description: Purchase order headers with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Purchase Value (Period)
panels.description: Sum of purchase order line value (order_price) for lines with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Suppliers Used (Period)
panels.description: Distinct creditors on purchase order lines with an order date in the current time range.

panels.title: Purchase Order Value Over Time
panels.description: Purchase order line value summed per order date (server-side $apply).

panels.title: Purchase Value by Supplier (Top 10)
panels.description: Purchase order line value grouped by supplier (creditor_id), for lines with an order date in the current time range (server-side $apply, top 10 client-side).

panels.title: Open Purchase Orders – Upcoming Deliveries
panels.description: Purchase order headers not yet closed, with an order date in the current time range, sorted by delivery date.

panels.title: Total Relations
panels.description: Total relations of any kind, not scoped to the dashboard time range or Administration (Relations are not administration-scoped).

panels.title: Customers (Debtors)
panels.description: Relations flagged as a debtor (customer).

panels.title: Suppliers (Creditors)
panels.description: Relations flagged as a creditor (supplier).

panels.title: New Relations (Period)
panels.description: Relations whose first-contact date falls in the current dashboard time range.

panels.title: New Relations Over Time (First Contact)
panels.description: New relations grouped by first-contact date, computed client-side via a Grafana group-by transformation (rather than OData $apply) to show that technique too.

panels.title: Relations by Role
panels.description: Count of relations flagged with each role. Roles are independent flags, not mutually exclusive - a relation can be both a debtor and a creditor, for example - so this is six separate counts (one query per role) rather than a single group-by/pie breakdown.

panels.title: Recent Relations
panels.description: Relations sorted by first-contact date, newest first. Not scoped by Administration (Relations are not administration-scoped).
